Kim S: FYI incoming QBR ask   We need a 2-slide mini: 1) account health + runway, 2) quick action playbook (throttle presets, one-time credit offer, enablement note). Targets: three onboarding accounts flagged by finance.
Andre P: I can take one. Which accounts?
Kim S: Finance sent Sable, Meridian, and Kestrel. Keep each slide super short: chart + one-liner + recommended action.
Lina Q: I'll own Sable. I'll pull 30/14/7 day burn and the top 5 api routes by token footprint.
Marco V: I'll take Meridian and check for embed rebuilds; if nightly rebuilds are present that's usually the culprit.
Andre P: Kestrel for me. I'll run a quick sensitivity grid for QPS {25,50} x seq {256,1024} and a cheap quantize estimate.
Kim S: New renewal flag: "hold" if (MoM burn increase >30% AND projected days left < 28). If flagged, propose a one-time buffer credit of $3k (legal cleared for onboarding pilots).
Lina Q: Noted. Also propose a throttle preset: {route: "bulk_embed_create", max_qps: 10, max_payload_tokens: 8192, backoff: 2s}. I'll paste JSON in slide.
Marco V: For Meridian I see full-index nightly rebuilds. Rough calc: 55% of 7d spend. Recommend incremental rebuilds + sample window; projected saving ~40%.
Andre P: Running sim:
```
./tools/spend_est --acct KESTREL --horizon 30 --qps 25,50 --lens 256,1024 --quantize --out kestrel-sim.csv
```
Kim S: Good. Add a small table: "days until credits" at current burn, and "days if quantized". That helps CS prioritize.
DataAccess Bot: Granting read to andre.p@redwood on project kestrel-prod-billing.csv.
DataAccess Bot: read granted to andre.p@redwood for kestrel-prod-billing.csv.
Andre P: Uploaded sim to drive: https://drive.redwood/kestrel/kestrel-sim.csv. Headline: 50qps@1024 -> ~$1.2k/day unopt, quantize saves ~30%.
Lina Q: Drafting enablement blurb: "Hey <acct>, we flagged a spend increase driven by nightly batch jobs and large context calls. Quick wins: 1) apply throttle preset for bulk routes 2) switch embeds to incremental rebuilds 3) enable quantization for batch. We can apply a one-time $3k credit to run a 10-day optimization pilot. Reply OK to schedule."
Marco V: Can DataOps give me read to meridian-billing-prod for raw events 90d?
DataAccess Bot: access granted to marco.v@redwood for meridian-billing-prod.
Kim S: Owners recap: Sable=Lina, Meridian=Marco, Kestrel=Andre, Enablement=Kim. Deliverables due Tue 2pm PT so I can assemble Wed AM QBR appendix. Dry-run Wed 4pm PT. Flag blockers here. :sparkles:
